_note: Typed by hand from each filing's report_url xHTML (income statement / results table), never from the parser. Revenue is the headline turnover in the reporting currency; EPS is in the reporting currency's major unit (pence / 100). null = the parser's concept list has no headline fact for it (see per-file why).
